// Update categories based on occasion
function updateCategories() {
  const occasion = document.getElementById("occasion").value;
  const categorySelect = document.getElementById("category");
  categorySelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Select Category --</option>';
  categorySelect.disabled = !occasion;

  if (occasion && menu[occasion]) {
    Object.keys(menu[occasion]).forEach(category => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = category;
      option.textContent = category;
      categorySelect.appendChild(option);
    });
  }
}

// Update items based on category
function updateItems() {
  const occasion = document.getElementById("occasion").value;
  const category = document.getElementById("category").value;
  const itemSelect = document.getElementById("item");
  itemSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Select Item --</option>';
  itemSelect.disabled = !category;

  if (category && menu[occasion]?.[category]) {
    menu[occasion][category].forEach(item => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = item.name;
      option.textContent = `${item.name} ($${item.total.toFixed(2)})`;
      itemSelect.appendChild(option);
    });
  }
}
